=== a program at the reset vector, with an interrupt vector
        ORG     0
        LJMP    MAIN
        ORG     0BH             ; timer 0 overflow
        CPL     P1.0
        RETI
        ORG     30H
MAIN:   MOV     SP,#5FH
        MOV     TMOD,#01H
        MOV     TH0,#0FCH
        MOV     TL0,#18H
        SETB    TR0
        SETB    ET0
        SETB    EA
LOOP:   SJMP    LOOP
=== every register name
        MOV     A,P0
        MOV     A,SP
        MOV     A,DPL
        MOV     A,DPH
        MOV     A,PCON
        MOV     A,TCON
        MOV     A,TMOD
        MOV     A,TL0
        MOV     A,TL1
        MOV     A,TH0
        MOV     A,TH1
        MOV     A,P1
        MOV     A,SCON
        MOV     A,SBUF
        MOV     A,P2
        MOV     A,IE
        MOV     A,IEC
        MOV     A,P3
        MOV     A,IP
        MOV     A,IPC
        MOV     A,PSW
        MOV     A,ACC
        MOV     A,B
=== every bit name
        SETB    IT0
        SETB    IE0
        SETB    IT1
        SETB    IE1
        SETB    TR0
        SETB    TF0
        SETB    TR1
        SETB    TF1
        SETB    RI
        SETB    TI
        SETB    RB8
        SETB    TB8
        SETB    REN
        SETB    SM2
        SETB    SM1
        SETB    SM0
        SETB    EX0
        SETB    ET0
        SETB    EX1
        SETB    ET1
        SETB    ES
        SETB    EA
        SETB    RXD
        SETB    TXD
        SETB    INT0
        SETB    INT1
        SETB    T0
        SETB    T1
        SETB    WR
        SETB    RD
        SETB    PX0
        SETB    PT0
        SETB    PX1
        SETB    PT1
        SETB    PS
        SETB    P
        SETB    OV
        SETB    RS0
        SETB    RS1
        SETB    F0
        SETB    AC
        JB      CY,$
=== names in lower case
        mov     a,acc
        mov     b,a
        mov     psw,#0
        mov     sp,#7
        setb    tr1
        clr     ea
        jnb     ri,$
        cpl     p1.7
=== the bit notation, on RAM and on registers
        SETB    20H.0
        CLR     2FH.7
        CPL     27H.4
        CPL     P1.3
        MOV     C,ACC.7
        MOV     PSW.5,C
        JB      TCON.5,$
        JNB     B.0,$
        JBC     20H.1,$
        ANL     C,/P3.2
        ORL     C,SCON.0
        SETB    P0.0
        CLR     IP.7
        SETB    IE.7
=== the bit notation with a named base and an expression
BASE    EQU     24H
        SETB    BASE.2
        CLR     (BASE+1).6
        MOV     C,P1.(1+2)
        CPL     P2.7+0
        SETB    20H+1.3
        CPL     P1.1+2
        CLR     BASE*1+1.8-1
=== CY as the carry, and as a bit
        CLR     CY
        SETB    CY
        CPL     CY
        MOV     CY,20H.0
        MOV     20H.1,CY
        MOV     C,CY
        ANL     CY,/ACC.0
        ORL     CY,B.1
        JB      CY,$
        JNB     CY,$
=== BIT and SFR symbols
LED     BIT     P1.0
FLAG    BIT     20H.3
MIRROR  BIT     FLAG
PORT    SFR     90H
LATCH   SFRB    0A0H
        SETB    LED
        CLR     FLAG
        JB      MIRROR,$
        MOV     PORT,#0FFH
        MOV     A,LATCH
        SETB    LATCH.4
=== BIT symbols used before they are defined
        SETB    LATER
        JNB     LATER,$
        MOV     C,LATER
LATER   BIT     2EH.5
=== EQU constants and forward references
        ORG     100H
START:  MOV     A,#COUNT
        MOV     R0,#BUFFER
        MOV     DPTR,#TABLE
        CALL    FILL
        LJMP    DONE
FILL:   MOV     @R0,A
        INC     R0
        DJNZ    ACC,FILL
        RET
TABLE:  DB      1,2,3,4
DONE:   SJMP    DONE
COUNT   EQU     8
BUFFER  EQU     30H
=== generic JMP and CALL, short, paged and long
        ORG     0
BACK:   JMP     BACK
        CALL    BACK
        JMP     NEAR
        JMP     PAGED
        CALL    PAGED
        JMP     FAR
        CALL    FAR
NEAR:   NOP
        ORG     400H
PAGED:  RET
        ORG     2000H
FAR:    RET
=== generic JMP and CALL across a block boundary
        ORG     7F0H
        JMP     810H
        CALL    810H
        JMP     900H
        CALL    7F0H
        ORG     900H
        JMP     0
        CALL    8F0H
        JMP     @A+DPTR
=== generic JMP that grows, moving a later jump out of its block
        ORG     7C0H
        JMP     FAR1
        DS      3AH
        CALL    NEAR1
NEAR1:  RET
        ORG     1000H
FAR1:   RET
=== AJMP and ACALL to every page of their block
        ORG     800H
        AJMP    800H
        AJMP    900H
        AJMP    0A00H
        AJMP    0B00H
        AJMP    0C00H
        ACALL   0D00H
        ACALL   0E00H
        ACALL   0FFFH
        ORG     0F00H
        AJMP    800H
        ACALL   0FFFH
=== AJMP and ACALL to labels either side of the instruction
        ORG     1000H
TOP:    NOP
        ORG     1400H
        AJMP    TOP
        ACALL   BOTTOM
        AJMP    $
        ORG     17F0H
BOTTOM: RET
=== AJMP ending a block, two bytes before its boundary
        ORG     7FAH
        AJMP    0
        ACALL   7FFH
        NOP
        NOP
=== relative branches at the edge of their reach, by label
        ORG     100H
        SJMP    FWD
        DS      127
FWD:    NOP
BWD:    DS      126
        SJMP    BWD
        JZ      FWD2
        DS      127
FWD2:   NOP
=== three-byte branches at the edge of their reach
        ORG     200H
        CJNE    A,#1,FWD
        DS      127
FWD:    DJNZ    30H,BWD
BWD:    NOP
        DS      124
        JB      20H.0,BWD
=== relative branches at the edge of their reach, from the location counter
        ORG     100H
        SJMP    $+129
        SJMP    $-126
        JNC     $-126
        DJNZ    R2,$-126
        JBC     P1.1,$-125
        CJNE    R3,#0,$-125
        CJNE    @R0,#0,$+130
        CJNE    A,30H,$-125
        DJNZ    30H,$+130
=== DB, DW and DS
        ORG     0
        MOV     DPTR,#MSG
        MOVC    A,@A+DPTR
        RET
MSG:    DB      'Hello',0DH,0AH,0
        ; `$` first: AS gives every item the statement's address, rsasm
        ; each item its own (see the 8-bit dialect notes).
        DW      $,1234H,MSG
        DS      4
        DB      'A'+1,-1,255
VEC:    DW      MSG
=== a lookup table through MOVC A,@A+PC
        ORG     0
        INC     A
        MOVC    A,@A+PC
        RET
        DB      3FH,06H,5BH,4FH
=== USING and the AR names
        USING   0
        PUSH    AR0
        PUSH    AR7
        USING   1
        PUSH    AR0
        POP     AR7
        USING   3
        MOV     A,AR5
        MOV     AR2,#1
=== an 8052-style register defined in the program
T2CON   SFRB    0C8H
RCAP2L  SFR     0CAH
TR2     BIT     T2CON.2
        MOV     RCAP2L,#0
        SETB    TR2
        CLR     T2CON.7
=== number spellings
        MOV     A,#12H
        MOV     A,#0FFH
        MOV     A,#11001010B
        MOV     A,#17Q
        MOV     A,#123
        MOV     A,#'Z'
        MOV     A,#-1
        MOV     A,#-128
        MOV     DPTR,#-1
        MOV     DPTR,#0FFFFH
        LJMP    -1
=== the location counter and arithmetic
        ORG     1234H
        MOV     DPTR,#$
        MOV     A,#$ & 0FFH
        MOV     B,#$ >> 8
        DW      $+2
        SJMP    $+2
=== conditional assembly and a macro
DEBUG   EQU     1
OUT     MACRO   PORTNUM,VALUE
        MOV     PORTNUM,#VALUE
        ENDM
        IF      DEBUG
        OUT     P1,55H
        ELSE
        OUT     P1,0AAH
        ENDIF
        OUT     P2,1
=== nested delay loops
        ORG     0
DELAY:  MOV     R7,#10
D1:     MOV     R6,#200
D2:     MOV     R5,#250
D3:     DJNZ    R5,D3
        DJNZ    R6,D2
        DJNZ    R7,D1
        RET
=== serial port setup and a transmit routine
        ORG     0
        MOV     SCON,#50H
        MOV     TMOD,#20H
        MOV     TH1,#0FDH
        SETB    TR1
        MOV     A,#'U'
        ACALL   PUTC
HALT:   SJMP    HALT
PUTC:   MOV     SBUF,A
WAIT:   JNB     TI,WAIT
        CLR     TI
        RET
=== external memory through DPTR and R0/R1
        ORG     0
        MOV     DPTR,#8000H
        MOVX    A,@DPTR
        INC     DPTR
        MOVX    @DPTR,A
        MOV     R0,#40H
        MOVX    A,@R0
        MOVX    @R1,A
        XCH     A,@R1
        XCHD    A,@R0
=== every addressing mode of MOV with symbols
SRC     EQU     31H
DST     EQU     32H
        MOV     A,R3
        MOV     A,SRC
        MOV     A,@R1
        MOV     A,#SRC
        MOV     R3,A
        MOV     R3,SRC
        MOV     R3,#SRC
        MOV     DST,A
        MOV     DST,R3
        MOV     DST,SRC
        MOV     DST,@R0
        MOV     DST,#SRC
        MOV     @R1,A
        MOV     @R1,SRC
        MOV     @R1,#SRC
        MOV     DPTR,#DST*256+SRC
        MOV     ACC,ACC
        MOV     B,ACC
=== labels without colons in the first column
        ORG     0
AGAIN   INC     R2
        CJNE    R2,#10,AGAIN
DONE    SJMP    DONE
=== END stops assembly
        NOP
        END
        NOP
